# Forms and Validation

- Use appropriate HTML input types.
- Always keep server-side validation authoritative.
- Show field errors near the relevant controls.
- Preserve user input after validation failures.
- Prevent accidental duplicate submission.
- Show submitting/success/error states.
- Make validation messages accessible.
- Do not disable required security validation for convenience.
